gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:bdac68d4-.description: Who are we? At Gen (NASDAQ: GEN), an S&P 500 company, we strive to give everyone the power to explore our shared digital world freely and safely. Today, Gen is one of the largest consumer digital-safety and financial-wellness companies, safeguarding more than 500M people worldwide and protecting their digital data, identity, privacy, and financial lives across the Norton, Avast, AVG, LifeLock, MoneyLion, and Avira brands. Our team is working to help shape the digital world to be a freer, fairer, and safer place through the application of science, technology, and human ingenuity, and we are looking for people who share our passion for contributing to a better online world. How do we work? This is a hybrid role expecting 3 days in the office per week at our New York, NY location. You’ll join MoneyLion, Gen’s financial-wellness platform that helps millions of people take control of their money, build credit, and grow a healthier financial life. About the role As Product Growth & Experimentation Manager, User Lifecycle, you’ll play a pivotal role on MoneyLion’s Growth & Retention team, driving user and revenue growth across the entire customer lifecycle. We are a customer-obsessed, data-driven group focused on delivering exceptional user experiences while unlocking meaningful monetization opportunities. Our mission is to strike the optimal balance between user value and business performance - by continually refining how, when, and where we engage users from activation through monetization, retention, and expansion. This role sits at the intersection of product, growth, and experimentation. You’ll own the experimentation and automation backbone that every lifecycle journey runs on - the testing framework that proves incremental impact, and the decisioning / automation layer (AID, Hightouch, Iterable) that powers personalized engagement at scale. You’ll set the objectives and guardrails our AI decisioning and AI agents operate within, design the experiments that prove what works, and turn results into the next round of automation. This is a high-impact individual-contributor role that requires close, collaborative partnership with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Creative, and the lifecycle journey managers. You’ll need strong strategic thinking, flawless execution, and a proactive mindset to push initiatives forward that directly contribute to our long-term growth objectives. What you’ll do • Build and own MoneyLion’s experimentation framework - holdouts, CRO, and A/B testing - and the incrementality and attribution methodology used across every lifecycle pillar (activation, monetization, retention, expansion). • Own the decisioning / automation layer: AID / Hightouch orchestration, eligibility, frequency, routing, and guardrails feeding Iterable, in-app, and ads. • Independently lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives across multiple growth and monetization touchpoints in the MoneyLion experience. • Enhance performance - analyze user funnels, execute A/B tests, and optimize journeys to maximize conversion, monetization, and retention. • Champion a test-and-learn culture - drive experimentation, promote data-first thinking, and lead innovation to accelerate growth. • Partner with each lifecycle journey manager to design tests that prove (or disprove) decisioning lift versus business-as-usual, and translate readouts into concrete automation improvements. • Support monetization and pricing decisions across first purchase, upsell, retention, and reactivation experiences with rigorous experiment design and clean reads. • Supervise and continuously improve the AI agents (rapid response, monitoring & forecasting, quality supervision) and set the guardrails they operate within. • Proactively identify opportunities and solve business, data, and technical challenges without needing step-by-step direction. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f1c0f557-3287-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Banking Onboarding Manager based in France. As a Banking Onboarding Manager, you will take ownership of complex corporate banking and EMI onboarding across multiple jurisdictions and high-risk industries. You will act as a key link between internal Finance and Legal teams and external banking partners, relationship managers, and compliance officers. Your expertise will help secure and maintain critical corporate accounts while ensuring demanding underwriting and regulatory requirements are met. You will manage KYC, KYB, and AML processes, coordinate detailed corporate documentation, and keep applications moving efficiently from submission through approval. The role requires strong knowledge of international banking, complex ownership structures, and compliance requirements, combined with persistence and excellent organization. You will also support ongoing banking relationships through annual reviews, transaction queries, and corporate structure updates. This is a highly autonomous, globally oriented role where your work directly supports the stability and scalability of essential financial operations. Own end-to-end onboarding and account-opening processes for operational and client bank and EMI accounts across multiple jurisdictions. Manage banking applications within high-risk industries, ensuring all requirements are understood, documented, and addressed accurately. Gather, review, structure, and submit corporate legal files, UBO ownership documentation, and operational flowcharts required for bank underwriting. Build and maintain strong working relationships with bank relationship managers, compliance officers, EMIs, and other financial partners. Track active applications closely, proactively follow up on outstanding requirements, and resolve issues to minimize account setup delays. Lead KYC, KYB, and AML processes, including complex onboarding cases, annual reviews, and ad-hoc compliance inquiries. Coordinate responses to transaction-related questions and provide banking partners with accurate and timely supporting information. Manage annual bank reviews and ensure corporate accounts remain compliant with changing requirements. Communicate corporate structure changes to relevant banking and financial partners and coordinate any resulting documentation or review processes. Support Finance and Legal teams with substance requirements across the corporate holding structure. Interpret and coordinate legal documentation such as Certificates of Incorporation, Registers of Directors, Incumbency Certificates, Powers of Attorney, and apostilled documents. Help manage banking and payment relationships across international payment routes, including SEPA and SWIFT. Maintain clear records of onboarding progress, documentation, requests, approvals, and outstanding actions. Identify potential onboarding or compliance bottlenecks early and work proactively with internal and external stakeholders to resolve them. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of banking onboarding processes, documentation standards, and partner-management practices. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience opening and managing corporate bank or EMI accounts, ideally within iGaming, cryptocurrency, high-risk FinTech, or another highly regulated environment. Strong understanding of complex UBO and corporate ownership structures and the documentation required to evidence them. Proven knowledge of bank underwriting requirements, apostilled documentation, and international corporate banking processes. Deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and AML requirements, including AML regulations and Source of Wealth (SoW) and Source of Funds (SoF) assessments.
